# ui::MessageBoxHost

Header: `winui/ui/MessageBox.hpp`.

What shows the message boxes [ui::message_box()](namespace-ui.md#message_box) asks for.

There is one for the whole process: the platform's, or a double a test installs with [`ui::testing::set_message_box_host()`](../testing/namespace-ui-testing.md#set_message_box_host). App code calls [ui::message_box()](namespace-ui.md#message_box) and never needs the class. It is public so a test double can derive from it.

## ~MessageBoxHost

```cpp
virtual ~MessageBoxHost() = default
```

## show

```cpp
virtual MessageBoxResult show(const Window* owner, const MessageBoxOptions& options) = 0
```

Shows `options` over `owner` (nullptr: no owner) and returns the user's answer.
